notes: Cross-verse consistency in rule 31's head for a single substantive rendered by an attributive plus an English noun. This chapter heads נִיר → fallow ground on fallow (4.3) and כַּרְמֶל → fruitful field on fruitful (4.26); שְׁפָיִים → the bare heights was headed on the English noun instead, with no source difference to license it. Only the target head of s017 changes, from t020 to t019.
